description: Verifies the plan JSON text against newer normalized log text using trazum verify logic. Returns arrived, not-arrived or cannot-tell per action, attribution and gate failures. A vanished workload does not count as savings; a route+batch result cannot prove batch billing.

log.description: Normalized usage-log text, one JSON object per line. Never a path.

plan.description: The JSON text of the plan field returned by plan_savings, or a saved trazum plan document. Never a path.

pricing_overlay.description: Optional pricing-overlay JSON text. Use the same rates for planning and verification.

name: verify_savings
title: Check a saved plan against later usage
